QUOTE: The high-level part is `ret & 0xFF80`. If it is nonzero, `mbedtls_high_level_strerr()` ... looks it up. ... The low-level part is `ret & ~0xFF80`. If it is nonzero, `mbedtls_low_level_strerr()` ... looks it up. If both parts are present, the strings are joined with `" : "`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer describes the high-level (module) and low-level parts of the code and says both are rendered and joined with " : " when both are present.
